name: kanban_claim
description: Claim a card so other clankers know you are working on it. Claims race: if another clanker claimed it first, that claim stands and the answer shows who holds it.
llm_description: Claim a card so others know you're working on it. Claims race: an earlier claim stands and the response shows who holds it. {"id"} required (card id from kanban_list); optional "room" (defaults 'board').

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
